N,10389 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of 7th day of July, 2006, among NORTHEAST COMMUNITY BANK, a federal savings bank having an office at 325 Hamilton Avenue, White Plains, NY 10601 ("Institution") and REGENCY EAST, LLC, a limited liability company having an address at c/o Halpern & Pintel, LLC 150 White Plains Road, Tarrytown, NY 10591 ("Owner"). Statements of Fact Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by. (a) the street address 1359 First Avenue aka 340 East 73rd Street, New York, New York; and (b)theTaxLotNumber30,Block 1447. Such land and tax lot is hereinafter referred to as "Lot A" or "Owner's Land", and is more particularly described on Schedule A attached hereto and made a part hereof. Such buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto and/or replacements thereof built on Owner's Land, are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owner's Building". The Owner's Land and the Owner's Building are hereinafter collectively referred to as the"Owner's Premises",being the same premises conveyed to Owner by deed from Regency East, a New York general partnership dated June 24, 1996 and recorded on November 8, 1996 in Reel 2390 at page 1692 as corrected by Correction Deed dated June 24, 1996 and recorded on March 25, 2003 in CRFN 2003000062542. Institution is the owner of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by: (a) the street addresses 1353-1355 First Avenue, New York, New York; and (b) theTaxLotNumber 27,Block 1447. Such land and tax lot is hereinafter collectively referred to as"Lot B"or"Institution's Land" and is more particularly described on Schedule B attached hereto and made a  s      s n r  and/or replacements thereof built on Institution's Land, are hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Institution's Building" and, with respect to the building thereon the "Institution's Existing Building". The Institution's Land and the Institution's Building are hereinafter collectivelyreferred to as the"Institution'sPremises".

Premises will contain more floor area than now is available for use on the Institution's Premises pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining the Owner's Land and the Institution's Land into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available the Excess Zoning Rights (hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of any new building,and Owner is willing to make such Excess Zoning Rights available to the Institution's Premises in perpetuity. The parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing and recording a Declaration of Restrictions(the"Declaration"),in accordance with certain provisions setforthinthedefinitionoftheterm"zoninglor"inSection12-10of the Zoning Resolution, in order to create a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lor") from the Owner's Land, the Institution's Land and such other parcels as may be included therein. NOW,THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereby agree as follows: 1. The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions ashereinaftersetforth: (a)"Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15,1961,as amended from time to time. (b)"Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot,to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by: (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area, and any use, bulk, density and other development rights, permitted under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of New York. (c)"Premises Development Rights" shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Owner's Premises.
